game_name: Initial D Arcade Stage Ver. 3 Cycraft Edition (Export, Rev B) (GDS-0039B)
general_issues: Select inidv3cy.zip. Select the exact set in Game Revision; merged archives must contain that revision. Keep naomi2.zip beside the ROM ZIP. Required CHD: gds-0039b.chd, initiald3_smcp_v1.66.chd. Select CHD Root below the ROM ZIP; disks may be in the set/parent subfolder or directly in that folder.
